description: Pill teal button that expands on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, width becomes 200px, height becomes 200px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Good Yak 38</title>
<style>
/* Good Yak 38 by Dear31 — https://uiverse.io/Dear31/good-yak-38 */
button {
  padding: 12px 32px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 3px black solid;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 1px;
  font-family: 'Lucida Sans', 'Lucida Sans Regular', 'Lucida Grande', 'Lucida Sans Unicode', Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17px;
  background-color: #01aaba68;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
}

button::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background-color: #199fab;
  width: 0px;
  height: 0px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  transition: all .3s ease-in;
  z-index: -1;
}

button:hover::after {
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: all .3s ease-in;
  width: 200px;
  height: 200px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Hover Me
</button>

</body>
</html>
